race.comment: MARTINI MUMMA (15) frustrating mare who gets another chance with the blinkers going on. Never looked comfortable on the soft (7) going before warming up late when seventh over 1200m here second-up. Senior rider hops on and she ticks a few boxes. Each way contender. SOMERTON SMART (8) heavily supported into favouritism first-up with a barnstorming win over 1115m at Grafton. Has a good record with Siena Grima aboard and deserves his chance in this class. WAYBURN (3) returns from a let-up and has his hoof on the till after going under narrowly in this company at his last two runs. Worth noting his best form is on a good surface and will be closing strongly. SOBEK (7) undefeated in three starts and deserves his chance in town. Kept fresh after he led throughout for a slick win over 1000m at Scone in BM66 grade. Since fitted with a trial win over 1200m. Maps well with the 3kg claimer and sure to be thereabouts. OH ARTHUR (12) sharp winner first-up and keep safe.
